description: Writes one key. Up to 1,000 elements and 1 MiB total; connection value-size and call limits also apply. Oversized writes are rejected in full.

encoding.description: base64: key is the base64 of a key that isn't UTF-8, as redis_scan lists it.

database.description: Required when several databases are selected. Defaults to the sole selected database.

valueEncoding.description: Encoding of value; independent of the key encoding.

condition.description: NX creates only if absent; XX replaces only if present.

ttlMs.description: Expiration in milliseconds. Cannot be combined with keepTtl=true.

keepTtl.description: Preserve the existing TTL. Without ttlMs or keepTtl=true, SET removes any TTL.
